name: Hyakki ~Inmoku Sareta Haikyo~
source:
"Ouka Island," an island once bustling with life...

With a circumference of just over one kilometer, the island nevertheless prospered with coal production, and at its peak was packed with 10-story buildings, boasting a population density that surpassed that of Tokyo.

With a public park, a shrine, even a school and a hospital, "Ouka Island" was a fine city despite its small scale.

However, due to main energy production switching from coal to oil, the island's coal mine was closed down.

As there were no other industries beside coal, most of the inhabitants had left the island in the span of over 3 months later.

Now even the buildings have been reduced to ruins......

An era sealed away...... "Ouka Island," an island of ruins, of which even memories have faded away, is where the story unfolds.

Joy, anger, sorrow, and eternal love......... What is the shocking truth shrouded in drama!?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150328084221/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/100/100ki.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
“樱花岛”，一座曾经充满生机的岛屿…

岛屿周长仅一公里多，却凭借煤炭生产繁荣一时。全盛时期，岛上遍布十层高楼，人口密度甚至超过东京。

公共公园、神社、学校乃至医院一应俱全。尽管规模不大，“樱花岛”依然是一座完善的城市。

然而，随着主要能源从煤炭转向石油，岛上的煤矿最终关闭。

除采煤外，岛上再无其他产业，因此仅仅三个多月，大部分居民便相继离去。

如今，就连那些建筑也已沦为废墟……

一个被封存的时代……故事就在“樱花岛”这座记忆都已逐渐褪色的废墟之岛上展开。

喜悦、愤怒、悲伤与永恒之爱………戏剧帷幕背后笼罩着怎样令人震惊的真相！？

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150328084221/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/100/100ki.html]官方网站[/url]]
